checks.claim: National Polygon INSERT is the date a polygon was initially created on the index map.
National Polygon UPDATE is the date all or part of the title was last updated.
Vers_No records the version of Poly_ID.
Title_No can link National Polygon records to Title Descriptor data.
Title_No can link National Polygon records to UPRN lookup data.
INSPIRE Index Polygons are a subset of National Polygon data.
INSPIRE attributes are simpler than National Polygon attributes.
INSPIRE polygons expose identifier, create date and polygon last-updated date.
